settings.label: How much fiber is in a can?
settings.text: Every 12 fl oz can has 9g of plant fiber, 2g sugar and 35 calories.

settings.label: Are there artificial sweeteners?
settings.text: No. Sweetness comes from fruit juice and botanicals, and the ingredient list stays short.

settings.label: What are the flavor families?
settings.text: Citrus is bright and zesty, Berry is jammy, Tropical is sunny, Classic is nostalgic and Spicy has a ginger kick.

settings.label: How should I store my cans?
settings.text: Keep them cool and dry, then chill before opening. Unopened cans stay fizzy for months.

settings.label: Where does Fizz ship from?
settings.text: Every pack is packed and shipped from our own warehouse, so we can check each order ourselves.

settings.heading: Join the Fizz Club
settings.message: New flavor drops, fridge deals and the odd cheeky pun. Once a week, no spam.
